items.lede: Elon Musk said Ukrainian president Volodymyr Zelenskyy is lying about disruptions to Starshield in Ukraine and that he's trying to misuse SpaceX's consumer service, Starlink, for military purposes. items.title: Elon Musk tries to explain what’s going on with Ukraine and Starlink
